content.name: Potion of Mind Reading
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the {@spell detect thoughts} spell (save {@dc 13}). The potion's dense, purple liquid has an ovoid cloud of pink floating in it.

content.name: Potion of Mind Reading
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the {@spell Detect Thoughts|SRD52} spell (save {@dc 13}) for 10 minutes (no {@status Concentration|SRD52} required).
This potion's dense, purple liquid has an ovoid cloud of pink floating in it.
